moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Further testing today revealed Giants QB Jaxson Dart’s knee injury is worse than initially thought, and the team and Dart now are facing the possibility of season‑ending knee surgery.
moments.why: A major NFL development—Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart likely done for the season—dominating sports talk among men 25‑45.

moments.author: Ilia Topuria
moments.quote: Final medical tests done. I’m back. ... Next time I’ll make sure they check Justin’s gloves so he doesn’t put anything weird on them.
moments.why: UFC comeback hype with a wild conspiracy about Gaethje’s gloves—plenty of swagger and controversy to draw attention.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Starlink is now often more reliable than cable.
moments.why: Bold tech claim from a high‑profile CEO—fueling debate on internet reliability and pushing Starlink into mainstream conversation.

moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Jaxson Dart suffered damage to his MCL, PCL and meniscus, per sources. The meniscus is the main issue.
moments.why: The follow‑up specificity on Dart’s injury details keeps the story trending in NFL circles.
